title: Machine Learning for Pre-Culture ESBL Risk Stratification to Guide Empiric Antibiotic Selection: A 12-Hospital Study of Enterobacteriaceae Cultures
abstract: arXiv:2609.05970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Empiric antibiotic therapy for suspected ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae must be selected 48-72 hours before culture results, forcing clinicians to choose between undertreating resistant infections and overusing carbapenems that drive further resistance. We developed a cost-sensitive XGBoost model predicting an ESBL phenotype (resistance to ceftriaxone, ceftazidime, cefepime or piperacillin-tazobactam) at culture ordering using 45 pre-culture EHR features across 132,955 cultures from 72,217 patients at 12 hospitals (14.41% with the ESBL phenotype). Cultures were partitioned at the patient level. At 90% sensitivity, the model achieved 95.8% NPV, reducing post-test ESBL probability to 4.2%, a threshold that may support safe carbapenem-sparing in non-ICU settings, while sparing 307 of every 1,000 cultures an unnecessary broad-spectrum course at the cost of 14 missed ESBL cases per 1,000. translated_title: 用于培养前ESBL风险分层以指导经验性抗生素选择的机器学习：一项涵盖12家医院的肠杆菌科细菌培养研究
translated_abstract: 疑似产ESBL（超广谱β-内酰胺酶）肠杆菌科细菌感染的经验性抗生素治疗必须在培养结果出来前48-72小时内选择，这迫使临床医生在治疗不足（导致耐药感染得不到控制）与过度使用碳青霉烯类药物（进而加剧耐药性）之间做出艰难抉择。我们开发了一个成本敏感的XGBoost模型，在开具培养医嘱时利用45个培养前电子健康记录（EHR）特征预测ESBL表型（即对头孢曲松、头孢他啶、头孢吡肟或哌拉西林-他唑巴坦耐药）。研究数据涵盖12家医院72,217名患者的132,955份培养样本（其中14.41%为ESBL表型），培养数据在患者层面进行了划分。在90%灵敏度下，该模型达到了95.8%的阴性预测值（NPV），将检测后ESBL概率降至4.2%，这一阈值可能支持在非ICU环境中安全地避免使用碳青霉烯类药物，同时每1,000份培养中约有307份可避免不必要的广谱抗生素疗程，代价是每1,000份培养中漏诊14例ESBL病例。SHAP分析显示既往ESBL定植是……（原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于培养前电子健康记录特征的机器学习模型，可在培养结果出来前预测ESBL感染风险，有望在非ICU环境中帮助临床医生安全地减少碳青霉烯类药物的过度使用。
en_tdlr: This study developed a machine learning model using pre-culture EHR features to predict ESBL phenotype before culture results are available, potentially enabling safe carbapenem-sparing antibiotic strategies in non-ICU settings.
